## Activity

During June 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 278 captures. This records the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during June 2021, 10 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.6. This result identifies the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the total number of captures for the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 51 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Together, these results summarise the grading workload and the time taken for images to progress from capture to review at Market Eye Clinic during June 2021.
